library.description: Request-scoped Store SSR dehydration and hydration.

blocks.text: 为每次服务端渲染登记 Store 与 Resource，捕获可复水的状态，并在请求结束时清理所拥有的对象。

items: 并发请求登记相同状态键，却读到了别人的值：模块级 Runtime 和共享登记表让请求数据归到了同一个所有者。
页面渲染时计数是 2，发送响应时却变成 3：响应仍指向活对象，没有捕获独立的数据副本。
一个请求还没完成，整份缓存就被当成超时：只给 Promise.all 加期限，无法区分已就绪与仍在途的资源。
JSON 能解析，内联页面却被截断：JSON 字符串中的关闭脚本标签仍会被 HTML 解析器当作标记。
让误传的请求状态在登记时暴露。 默认创建新 Runtime，登记时再检查精确身份，见让两个请求使用各自的运行时。
固定渲染时捕获的值，并收拢请求清理。 安全脱水校验、复制和冻结数据，默认拥有的 Store 随请求关闭释放，见捕获请求快照并释放所拥有的状态。
分别识别就绪缓存与在途超时。 等待按 Promise 结算情况分类，零预算也识别已完成结果，见保留就绪数据并报告仍在途的资源。
把 HTML 中的 JSON 正文转义集中到一个入口。 序列化转义五类敏感字符并保留 JSON 读回值，见内联 JSON 时避免数据提前关闭脚本元素。
用经过校验的标识生成一致的状态元素。 标签生成器固定 JSON MIME 类型并拒绝突破属性边界的标识，见拒绝会破坏状态元素属性的标识符。

blocks.code:
import { createSSRRequestScope } from '@migaia/store-ssr'
import { createStore } from '@migaia/store-light'

const scope = createSSRRequestScope()
const cart = createStore({ count: 2 }, { runtime: scope.runtime })
scope.register('cart', cart)
const snapshot = scope.dehydrate()
cart.count = 3
console.log(snapshot.stores.cart?.count, cart.count)
console.log(Object.isFrozen(snapshot.stores.cart))
await scope.disposeAsync()
console.log(cart.$disposed)

blocks.text: 本包只有根入口 `@migaia/store-ssr`。它连接 reactive 驱动的 Store/Resource 与 SSR 快照，管理请求内登记、预取等待、脱水、复水和已接纳对象的清理；依赖 reactive、resource、serialize、utils，不绑定渲染框架，也不读 globalThis.document。

每个请求默认创建新的 SSRRequestScope 和 Runtime。register 检查 store.$runtime，registerResource 检查 resource.runtime，必须等于 scope.runtime；不匹配抛 CROSS_RUNTIME。claimOwnership 登记 scope 对象的归属，不独占 Runtime：调用方显式传同一个 Runtime 给两个 scope 是允许的，库无法据此自动隔离请求。正确的接入是每请求创建独立 scope，用 scope.runtime 创建该请求状态，并在 finally 中 await disposeAsync。
createStore 返回值和 Resource 类分别满足下文的 Store/Resource 接口，不需要另造适配层。纯客户端应用不需要这座 SSR 桥；它也不是通用的任意对象 JSON 转换器。客户端是否重发数据请求还取决于 Resource 的缓存、TTL 和启动策略，复水不保证所有业务都不再请求。
createSSRRequestScope(options?) 等价于 new SSRRequestScope(options?)，options 默认空对象：

rows: 未提供时内部 createRuntime() 新建；显式提供时复用
undefined；转给内部 createRuntime，与 runtime 互斥

blocks.text: runtimeOptions 是 reactive 的选项，包含 onError、onTrace、maxFlushPasses、scheduleIdle 等，由 reactive 定义具体语义；本包没有另建运行时选项。两项同时提供以 INVALID_OPTION 拒绝。scope.runtime 只读，scope.disposed 表示已开始同步关闭。
Resource 没有可脱水缓存时可返回 undefined。Store 使用 $ 前缀、Resource 不使用，是各自原接口的约定。异步 Store cleanup 由 scope 观察；Resource port 的 dispose 是同步接口。结构适配器必须按自身缓存策略提供 dehydrate，不能假设失败记录会替它决定是否输出缓存。

blocks.text: key 必须非空且不能为 `__proto__`。Store 与 Resource 各自的重复 key 以 INVALID_OPTION 拒绝，不静默覆盖。登记对象必须属于当前 Runtime。owned true 在 scope 退出时负责清理；owned false 只参与脱水/复水，资源仍归调用方。
hydrate 先于登记到达时，register 会在提交登记前应用同 key 待处理快照。回调失败且 scope 仍活跃时，key 仍空闲，待处理快照保留以便重试，候选仍归调用方；若回调关闭了 scope，关闭会清空待处理表，提交前再次拒绝 SCOPE_DISPOSED，候选可能已被水合但未被接纳。
Store 注销先摘登记再启动 $dispose，thenable 由 scope 追踪；Resource 注销先调用 dispose，若同步失败，登记仍在，可由调用方 detach 或处理后重试。detach 从不销毁，成功后生命周期责任转给调用方。
hydrate(state) 只有必填 state 参数，无额外选项。先 assertSSRState 校验全部结构，再对已登记对象调用 $hydrate/hydrate，未知 key 放入待处理表，之后同 key 登记时应用。每次 hydrate 整体替换待处理表，新状态未包含的旧待处理项不保留。
这是尽力而为的操作，不是原子事务。一个回调失败不阻止其他条目尝试，已经应用的状态不回滚。单个失败原样抛出；多个失败通过 HYDRATE_FAILED 的 AggregateError.errors 保留原对象和顺序。key 拼写、快照是否含该 key 及服务端脱水时对象是否已销毁，都影响客户端恢复结果。

dehydrate() 无参数，按 key 字典序遍历未销毁的已登记对象。Store 的 $plain() 经 JSON 校验、深拷贝和冻结；Resource 的 dehydrate() 返回 undefined 时跳过，有值时只对 data 深拷贝校验，保留 version、ageMs、remainingTtlMs。外层 state、stores、resources 都冻结，脱水后源对象变化不改变这份安全快照。
dehydrateTrusted() 无参数，但它不是快照。它保留 $plain()/dehydrate() 的活引用，不做 JSON 校验、深拷贝或深冻结；只有外层包装不等于整棵数据不可变。ITrustedSSRState 有不可外部构造的类型品牌，serializeTrustedSSRState 只接受这条路径产出的类型，不是对不可信数据的安全证明。
选择 trusted 路径必须已知所有值合法且不会在序列化前改变，随后立即 serializeTrustedSSRState，中间不要 await 或 mutation。默认使用 dehydrate，不能因为有品牌就把请求输入当作已验证数据。dehydrate/dehydrateAsync 只产出数据，不负责 HTML 字符转义。

awaitResources(options?) 返回 readonly ISSRResourceFailure[]；每项包含 key 和原始 error。options 默认 {}，timeoutMs 默认 undefined，不设期限；提供时须为 [0, 2147483647] 内的有限非负数，可为小数，非法值让返回 Promise 以 RangeError / INVALID_OPTION 拒绝。
timeoutMs 是整个等待的总预算，不是每个 Resource 各得一份。逐轮按 Promise 身份去重，新 retry/refetch Promise 仍会被等待；瀑布式完成后登记的新 Resource 也会进入后续轮次。超过 64 轮以 RESOURCE_ROUND_LIMIT 拒绝。
读取 promise getter 的失败按 key 只记一次；原 Promise 拒绝保留其原因；预算耗尽只把仍 pending 的 Promise 记为 RESOURCE_TIMEOUT，已成功的不误报。timeoutMs 0 不等在途任务，但仍识别已完成 Promise。scope 关闭会让等待尽快返回已收集失败，不把剩余项统一报超时，也不取消这些 Resource 的底层工作。

dehydrateAsync(options?) 先等待再安全脱水，字段 timeoutMs 同上；onResourceError(failure) 可选，无默认用户回调。未传时每项失败交 runtime.reportError(error, { phase: 'ssr-resource' })，传入后替代默认报告。失败清单不按 key 另行删除 state.resources，是否输出由 Resource.dehydrate() 决定。没有期限的永不 settle 工作可一直等待，调用方应按请求预算显式选择 timeoutMs。
Resource v2 hydration 恢复捕获时的剩余 TTL。已知传输或存储耗时应由调用方计入 ageMs，并从有限 remainingTtlMs 扣除、最低为 0；外层 ISSRState.version 仍是 1。
dispose() 无参数，同步关闭入口并启动清理；disposeAsync() 无参数，返回稳定的 Promise<void>。首次关闭先标记 disposed、清空登记与待水合表并发布完成 Promise，再执行回调。因此清理中的同步重入也取得同一个完成 Promise；重复调用、完成后与失败后均稳定复用，不再释放一次。

释放顺序是注册逆序的 owned Resource，再注册逆序的 owned Store，已销毁项跳过。每项失败不阻断其余项。同步 dispose 可抛同步失败，但不等待异步 Store thenable；disposeAsync 等全部已追踪清理完成，单错保留原对象，多错以 SCOPE_DISPOSAL_FAILED 的 AggregateError.errors 汇总。它也等待由此前 unregister 启动、仍在追踪的 Store cleanup。
scope 不销毁 Runtime 本体。关闭后除 runtime/disposed 观察和幂等关闭外，登记、注销、detach、hydrate、脱水与资源等待以 SCOPE_DISPOSED 失败；同步方法抛错，异步等待方法拒绝。scope 一次性使用，不支持复活。

ISSRState 要求 version: 1、stores 普通对象；resources 可选。每个 Store 值必须是 JSON 对象，key 非空且不为 `__proto__`。Resource 快照要求 version: 2、data、有限非负 ageMs，以及 null 或有限非负 remainingTtlMs。assertSSRState(value) 只有必填 value，无选项，校验通过后收窄类型，不是创建一份深拷贝。

JSON 域是 null、字符串、布尔、有限数、普通对象与数组。拒绝 Date/Map/Set/类实例、非有限数、undefined/函数/symbol/bigint 等非 JSON 类型、祖先循环、深度超过 256、节点超过 1000000；路径指向 stores.app.count 或 resources.user.data[2].name 等位置。相同无环对象的重复引用不等于祖先循环。拷贝与纯校验共享同一判定顺序。
INVALID_SNAPSHOT 用于 stores/resources 结构与资源快照错误；外层版本错误为 INVALID_STATE_SCRIPT。读取未知快照属性失败保留 native 原对象或 cause，不用新字符串替换失败。序列化不支持的 JSON 值为 TypeError / SERIALIZE_UNSUPPORTED。

sections.heading: JSON 文本、HTML 嵌入与显式 document

blocks.text: serializeSSRState(state) 先校验、JSON.stringify，再对 &、<、>、U+2028、U+2029 做 JSON 兼容转义，返回文本，不包标签。serializeTrustedSSRState(state) 跳过校验但仍执行这些转义。两者各只有一个必填参数，不是任意 HTML 上下文的通用转义器。

转义结果分别含字面反斜杠序列 \u0026、\u003c、\u003e、\u2028、\u2029，防止 payload 的 `</script>` 提前结束对应 script；JSON.parse 仍读回原字符。deserializeSSRState(text) 执行 JSON.parse 和 assertSSRState，SyntaxError 原位附 INVALID_STATE_SCRIPT，保留原生类型与 stack。
createSSRStateScript(state, elementId?) 把安全文本放入完整 application/json script 标签。state 必填；elementId 默认 `__STORE_STATE__`，须匹配 `/^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_:.-]*$/`，允许首个下划线并排除空白和引号，非法时 INVALID_STATE_SCRIPT。

readSSRStateFromDocument(elementId?, document?) 默认同一 id；document 默认 undefined，未传不读全局 DOM。document.getElementById(id) 返回含 textContent 与 getAttribute(name) 的元素或 null；没有元素或空内容返回 undefined。真实浏览器 document 满足此最小接口，非浏览器宿主也可显式实现它。返回数据仍须通过 SSR 校验。

blocks.text: 如果 encode 返回 value chunk，以 TypeError / CODEC_CONTRACT 拒绝：SSR 需要线上文本或字节。primaryType 为 json 且 chunk 为 text 时使用 JSON 字符转义，属性为 data-codec="json" data-wire="text"。其他情况，包括 JSON 的 bytes，使用 base64，data-wire="b64"、type="text/plain"；不能把 JSON 转义套到 YAML 或二进制语法上。base64 字母表避免相关 HTML 分隔字符，编码体积约增加三分之一，这是编码规则而非速度测量。

多 codec 标签的 id 及 codec 属性按 HTML 属性规则转义 &、双引号、单引号、<、>。这不替代 id 的准入规则。读者取 data-codec（默认 json）与 data-wire（默认 text）决定还原方式；未注册写入类型以 CODEC_CONTRACT 拒绝，解码后的结果仍经过 assertSSRState。写入和读取必须有兼容 registry，registry.encode 本身不代替 SSR helper 的嵌入策略。

SsrWireType 是 { json: 'json', text: 'text', bytes: 'bytes' }，ISsrWireType 为值联合。json 比较 codec type，text/bytes 比较 chunk kind，不能把这三个词混为同一层。内部等待标签 SsrWorkOutcome/ISsrWorkOutcome 已从根入口收回，不增加 wrapper 或兼容 alias；awaitResources 仍直接返回失败数组。

blocks.text: createStoreSsrError(code, message, options?) 构造 Error，options 可含 cause；createStoreSsrRangeError(code, message) 与 createStoreSsrTypeError(code, message) 仅两个参数，没有 cause 选项。code 和 message 必填，无默认。createStoreSsrAggregateError(code, errors, message) 构造 AggregateError，三参数必填，errors[] 保留原对象与顺序。工厂借 utils 的 attachErrorIdentity 附身份，不重写 stack。已有 native SyntaxError/TypeError 的准入失败在可附码时原位保留类型、实例和 stack，不可写或非 Error 原因通过 cause 保留。

服务端每请求创建 scope，用 scope.runtime 创建真实 Store/Resource 并按 key 登记；有预取时 dehydrateAsync，随后用对应 serialize/script helper 输出，finally 中 await disposeAsync。浏览器创建自己的 Runtime 和状态对象，显式读取同 id，按同 key hydrate；Resource 的 autoStart、缓存和 TTL 由 resource 包及应用决定。注入 snapshot、发送响应和页面渲染都是宿主职责，本包不替应用创建请求上下文。
遇到 CROSS_RUNTIME 检查对象创建时是否传入 scope.runtime。水合没变化检查 key、服务端是否含该条目和对象是否已销毁。资源缺 key 应查看 dehydrate() 的返回值，而不是把 failure 名单当 payload 过滤器。脚本读回失败检查 id 和 codec 配置；等待不结束区分无期限的在途 Resource 与清理边界。

sections.heading: 捕获请求快照并释放所拥有的状态

blocks.text: 页面完成渲染后，状态容器在序列化前又发生变化，导出状态应保留该次渲染捕获的值，请求清理也须释放其拥有的容器。
把嵌套活对象直接当响应载荷，会让后续修改改写此前结果；请求处理器若漏掉容器销毁，还会留下订阅与清理作业。
直接安装 `store-ssr` 与 `store-light`，以 `scope.runtime` 创建容器并登记，再用 `dehydrate()` 取得经校验的冻结快照，请求结束时等待 `disposeAsync()`。
createSSRRequestScope() 不传选项，内部新建 Runtime；register 的 key 与 Store 必填，owned 默认 true，Store 以 scope.runtime 创建。

blocks.code:
import { createSSRRequestScope } from '@migaia/store-ssr'
import { createStore } from '@migaia/store-light'

const scope = createSSRRequestScope()
const cart = createStore({ count: 2 }, { runtime: scope.runtime })
scope.register('cart', cart)
const snapshot = scope.dehydrate()
cart.count = 3
console.log(snapshot.stores.cart?.count, cart.count)
console.log(Object.isFrozen(snapshot.stores.cart))
await scope.disposeAsync()
console.log(cart.$disposed)

blocks.text: 逐行输出 `2 3`、`true`、`true`，活容器变为 `3` 后脱水值仍为 `2`，快照已冻结，请求完成时所拥有容器也已销毁。
登记默认拥有容器，`dehydrate()` 校验、复制并冻结 JSON 数据，`dehydrateTrusted()` 则保留活引用；作用域清理不销毁运行时本体，由调用者为每请求创建独立作用域。

sections.id: 让两个请求使用各自的运行时
sections.heading: 让两个请求使用各自的运行时

blocks.text: 并发请求为不同用户登记相同的个人资料键，需要隔离状态，也须拒绝误传另一个请求所创建的容器。
模块级运行时或共享登记表会让请求状态归同一所有者，仅给作用域不同名字，无法纠正使用错误运行时构造的容器。
`createSSRRequestScope` 默认创建新运行时，各真实 `store-light` 容器使用自身的 `scope.runtime`，`register()` 接纳前检查精确运行时身份。
两个 createSSRRequestScope() 都使用默认新 Runtime；相同 key 分别属于各自登记表，register 在接纳前检查 Store.$runtime。
逐行输出 `false`、`Alice Bob`、`CROSS_RUNTIME`，默认作用域的运行时不同，相同键保存各自用户值，跨运行时登记被拒绝。
向多个作用域显式传同一个 `runtime` 会复用它，不能获得请求隔离；`runtime` 与 `runtimeOptions` 互斥，登记失败后候选仍归调用者，关闭一个作用域不释放另一个拥有的对象。

sections.id: 保留就绪数据并报告仍在途的资源
sections.heading: 保留就绪数据并报告仍在途的资源

blocks.text: 渲染已有一项就绪缓存，等待预算结束时另一项请求仍在途中，已完成条目应继续可用，不应被误标为超时。
对整个 `Promise.all` 统一报超时，会丢失各资源实际结算情况，全部重试又会丢弃可用缓存并重复已成功的工作。
直接安装资源包，`dehydrateAsync({ timeoutMs: 0 })` 识别已结算结果而不等待在途工作，通过 `onResourceError` 收集失败，就绪资源使用 `60000` 毫秒缓存有效期。
Resource 使用 scope.runtime；ttl 默认 Infinity，本例把 ready 的 ttl 覆盖为 60000 毫秒；timeoutMs: 0 是整个等待的零预算，onResourceError 替代默认报告。
逐行输出 `pending RESOURCE_TIMEOUT`、`7`，仅未完成资源收到报告，成功缓存值仍在脱水资源状态中，随后示例完成在途加载并关闭作用域。
`timeoutMs` 默认无截止期限，预算覆盖整个等待，超时不会中止底层工作；是否纳入由资源自身脱水决定，不会额外按失败键过滤，旧缓存仍可能符合纳入条件。

sections.id: 内联-json-时避免数据提前关闭脚本元素
sections.heading: 内联 JSON 时避免数据提前关闭脚本元素

blocks.text: 用户文本包含 `</script>`、与号或 Unicode 行分隔符，把普通 JSON 内联进 HTML 脚本元素，可能让解析器把数据解释成标记。
`JSON.stringify` 转义 JSON 语法，却不会去掉字符串中的字面关闭脚本标签，之后再转义整份页面又可能损坏 JSON 表示。
`serializeSSRState` 先校验版本 `1` 状态，再用 JSON 兼容序列转义 `&`、`<`、`>`、U+2028 与 U+2029，用 `deserializeSSRState` 读回并核对同值。
state 必须是 version: 1 的合法 SSR 状态，serializeSSRState 与 deserializeSSRState 各接受一个必填参数，无额外选项。

blocks.code:
import { serializeSSRState, deserializeSSRState } from '@migaia/store-ssr'

const value = '</script>&\u2028\u2029'
const state = { version: 1 as const, stores: { page: { text: value } } }
const text = serializeSSRState(state)
console.log(
  text.includes('<'),
  text.includes('&'),
  text.includes('\u2028'),
  text.includes('\u2029')
)
console.log(deserializeSSRState(text).stores.page?.text === value)

blocks.text: 逐行输出 `false false false false`、`true`，序列化文本不含所检查的原始 HTML 敏感字符或行分隔符，JSON 解析仍精确恢复原字符串。
返回文本用于 JSON 脚本正文，函数不添加脚本元素，状态版本须为 `1`，值须符合支持的 JSON 值域；非法 JSON 解析保留 `SyntaxError` 并附 `INVALID_STATE_SCRIPT`。

sections.id: 生成完整的不可执行状态元素
sections.heading: 生成完整的不可执行状态元素

blocks.text: 渲染器已有合法状态外层，还需要为浏览器复水生成名称一致的元素，响应应包含数据，而不把 JSON 变成可执行 JavaScript。
手写标签模板容易在元素标识或 MIME 类型上不一致，没有配套转义便直接内联 JSON，还会让各渲染器重复处理关闭标签。
`createSSRStateScript` 校验状态与元素标识，按 HTML 上下文转义 JSON，再包装为 `application/json` 脚本，省略 `elementId` 时使用 `__STORE_STATE__`。
state 必填，elementId 省略时为 `__STORE_STATE__`；该函数返回标签文本，不插入 DOM。
输出 `<script type="application/json" id="__STORE_STATE__">{"version":1,"stores":{"app":{"count":2}}}</script>`，完整标签包含默认标识与不可执行 JSON MIME 类型。
此函数生成 HTML 文本，不插入 DOM 节点或复水容器，浏览器可用同一标识和显式文档调用 `readSSRStateFromDocument`，读取器不会自动取得全局文档。

sections.id: 拒绝会破坏状态元素属性的标识符
sections.heading: 拒绝会破坏状态元素属性的标识符

blocks.text: 渲染器从配置中选择元素标识，若接纳引号或空白，该值便可能逃出 `id` 属性并改变生成标记。
把任意配置字符串插入标签，会把该值当成 HTML 语法，仅让服务端与浏览器约定同一标识，不能校验属性边界。
`createSSRStateScript` 要求标识以字母或下划线开头，后续仅含字母、数字、下划线、冒号、点或连字符；先展示合法自定义标识，再拒绝带引号及空白的值。
elementId 为第二个参数，默认 `__STORE_STATE__`，须匹配 /^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_:.-]*$/；非法值以 INVALID_STATE_SCRIPT 拒绝。
逐行输出 `true`、`Error INVALID_STATE_SCRIPT`，合法的 `page-state` 被写入，尝试突破属性边界的标识在返回标签前被拒绝。
默认标识为 `__STORE_STATE__`，空或不匹配的标识会拒绝，状态数据另行校验并转义 JSON，此标识规则不替其他页面标记提供通用 HTML 清洗策略。
本包只有根入口 `@migaia/store-ssr`。它连接 reactive 驱动的 Store/Resource 与 SSR 快照，管理请求内登记、预取等待、脱水、复水和已接纳对象的清理；依赖 reactive、resource、serialize、utils，不绑定渲染框架，也不读 globalThis.document。

每个请求默认创建新的 SSRRequestScope 和 Runtime。register 检查 store.$runtime，registerResource 检查 resource.runtime，必须等于 scope.runtime；不匹配抛 CROSS_RUNTIME。claimOwnership 登记 scope 对象的归属，不独占 Runtime：调用方显式传同一个 Runtime 给两个 scope 是允许的，库无法据此自动隔离请求。正确的接入是每请求创建独立 scope，用 scope.runtime 创建该请求状态，并在 finally 中 await disposeAsync。
createStore 返回值和 Resource 类分别满足下文的 Store/Resource 接口，不需要另造适配层。纯客户端应用不需要这座 SSR 桥；它也不是通用的任意对象 JSON 转换器。客户端是否重发数据请求还取决于 Resource 的缓存、TTL 和启动策略，复水不保证所有业务都不再请求。
createSSRRequestScope(options?) 等价于 new SSRRequestScope(options?)，options 默认空对象：

rows: 未提供时内部 createRuntime() 新建；显式提供时复用
undefined；转给内部 createRuntime，与 runtime 互斥

blocks.text: runtimeOptions 是 reactive 的选项，包含 onError、onTrace、maxFlushPasses、scheduleIdle 等，由 reactive 定义具体语义；本包没有另建运行时选项。两项同时提供以 INVALID_OPTION 拒绝。scope.runtime 只读，scope.disposed 表示已开始同步关闭。
Resource 没有可脱水缓存时可返回 undefined。Store 使用 $ 前缀、Resource 不使用，是各自原接口的约定。异步 Store cleanup 由 scope 观察；Resource port 的 dispose 是同步接口。结构适配器必须按自身缓存策略提供 dehydrate，不能假设失败记录会替它决定是否输出缓存。

rows: key/store 必填，options 默认 {}，owned 默认 true；返回 void
key 必填，disposeOwned 默认 true；返回是否找到登记
返回原 Store 或 undefined，只移除不销毁
Resource 版本，同样默认 owned true
Resource 版本，返回是否找到登记
返回原 Resource 或 undefined，只移除不销毁

blocks.text: key 必须非空且不能为 `__proto__`。Store 与 Resource 各自的重复 key 以 INVALID_OPTION 拒绝，不静默覆盖。登记对象必须属于当前 Runtime。owned true 在 scope 退出时负责清理；owned false 只参与脱水/复水，资源仍归调用方。
hydrate 先于登记到达时，register 会在提交登记前应用同 key 待处理快照。回调失败且 scope 仍活跃时，key 仍空闲，待处理快照保留以便重试，候选仍归调用方；若回调关闭了 scope，关闭会清空待处理表，提交前再次拒绝 SCOPE_DISPOSED，候选可能已被水合但未被接纳。
Store 注销先摘登记再启动 $dispose，thenable 由 scope 追踪；Resource 注销先调用 dispose，若同步失败，登记仍在，可由调用方 detach 或处理后重试。detach 从不销毁，成功后生命周期责任转给调用方。
hydrate(state) 只有必填 state 参数，无额外选项。先 assertSSRState 校验全部结构，再对已登记对象调用 $hydrate/hydrate，未知 key 放入待处理表，之后同 key 登记时应用。每次 hydrate 整体替换待处理表，新状态未包含的旧待处理项不保留。
这是尽力而为的操作，不是原子事务。一个回调失败不阻止其他条目尝试，已经应用的状态不回滚。单个失败原样抛出；多个失败通过 HYDRATE_FAILED 的 AggregateError.errors 保留原对象和顺序。key 拼写、快照是否含该 key 及服务端脱水时对象是否已销毁，都影响客户端恢复结果。

dehydrate() 无参数，按 key 字典序遍历未销毁的已登记对象。Store 的 $plain() 经 JSON 校验、深拷贝和冻结；Resource 的 dehydrate() 返回 undefined 时跳过，有值时只对 data 深拷贝校验，保留 version、ageMs、remainingTtlMs。外层 state、stores、resources 都冻结，脱水后源对象变化不改变这份安全快照。
dehydrateTrusted() 无参数，但它不是快照。它保留 $plain()/dehydrate() 的活引用，不做 JSON 校验、深拷贝或深冻结；只有外层包装不等于整棵数据不可变。ITrustedSSRState 有不可外部构造的类型品牌，serializeTrustedSSRState 只接受这条路径产出的类型，不是对不可信数据的安全证明。
选择 trusted 路径必须已知所有值合法且不会在序列化前改变，随后立即 serializeTrustedSSRState，中间不要 await 或 mutation。默认使用 dehydrate，不能因为有品牌就把请求输入当作已验证数据。dehydrate/dehydrateAsync 只产出数据，不负责 HTML 字符转义。

awaitResources(options?) 返回 readonly ISSRResourceFailure[]；每项包含 key 和原始 error。options 默认 {}，timeoutMs 默认 undefined，不设期限；提供时须为 [0, 2147483647] 内的有限非负数，可为小数，非法值让返回 Promise 以 RangeError / INVALID_OPTION 拒绝。
timeoutMs 是整个等待的总预算，不是每个 Resource 各得一份。逐轮按 Promise 身份去重，新 retry/refetch Promise 仍会被等待；瀑布式完成后登记的新 Resource 也会进入后续轮次。超过 64 轮以 RESOURCE_ROUND_LIMIT 拒绝。
读取 promise getter 的失败按 key 只记一次；原 Promise 拒绝保留其原因；预算耗尽只把仍 pending 的 Promise 记为 RESOURCE_TIMEOUT，已成功的不误报。timeoutMs 0 不等在途任务，但仍识别已完成 Promise。scope 关闭会让等待尽快返回已收集失败，不把剩余项统一报超时，也不取消这些 Resource 的底层工作。

dehydrateAsync(options?) 先等待再安全脱水，字段 timeoutMs 同上；onResourceError(failure) 可选，无默认用户回调。未传时每项失败交 runtime.reportError(error, { phase: 'ssr-resource' })，传入后替代默认报告。失败清单不按 key 另行删除 state.resources，是否输出由 Resource.dehydrate() 决定。没有期限的永不 settle 工作可一直等待，调用方应按请求预算显式选择 timeoutMs。
Resource v2 hydration 恢复捕获时的剩余 TTL。已知传输或存储耗时应由调用方计入 ageMs，并从有限 remainingTtlMs 扣除、最低为 0；外层 ISSRState.version 仍是 1。
dispose() 无参数，同步关闭入口并启动清理；disposeAsync() 无参数，返回稳定的 Promise<void>。首次关闭先标记 disposed、清空登记与待水合表并发布完成 Promise，再执行回调。因此清理中的同步重入也取得同一个完成 Promise；重复调用、完成后与失败后均稳定复用，不再释放一次。

释放顺序是注册逆序的 owned Resource，再注册逆序的 owned Store，已销毁项跳过。每项失败不阻断其余项。同步 dispose 可抛同步失败，但不等待异步 Store thenable；disposeAsync 等全部已追踪清理完成，单错保留原对象，多错以 SCOPE_DISPOSAL_FAILED 的 AggregateError.errors 汇总。它也等待由此前 unregister 启动、仍在追踪的 Store cleanup。
scope 不销毁 Runtime 本体。关闭后除 runtime/disposed 观察和幂等关闭外，登记、注销、detach、hydrate、脱水与资源等待以 SCOPE_DISPOSED 失败；同步方法抛错，异步等待方法拒绝。scope 一次性使用，不支持复活。

ISSRState 要求 version: 1、stores 普通对象；resources 可选。每个 Store 值必须是 JSON 对象，key 非空且不为 `__proto__`。Resource 快照要求 version: 2、data、有限非负 ageMs，以及 null 或有限非负 remainingTtlMs。assertSSRState(value) 只有必填 value，无选项，校验通过后收窄类型，不是创建一份深拷贝。

JSON 域是 null、字符串、布尔、有限数、普通对象与数组。拒绝 Date/Map/Set/类实例、非有限数、undefined/函数/symbol/bigint 等非 JSON 类型、祖先循环、深度超过 256、节点超过 1000000；路径指向 stores.app.count 或 resources.user.data[2].name 等位置。相同无环对象的重复引用不等于祖先循环。拷贝与纯校验共享同一判定顺序。
INVALID_SNAPSHOT 用于 stores/resources 结构与资源快照错误；外层版本错误为 INVALID_STATE_SCRIPT。读取未知快照属性失败保留 native 原对象或 cause，不用新字符串替换失败。序列化不支持的 JSON 值为 TypeError / SERIALIZE_UNSUPPORTED。

sections.heading: JSON 文本、HTML 嵌入与显式 document

blocks.text: serializeSSRState(state) 先校验、JSON.stringify，再对 &、<、>、U+2028、U+2029 做 JSON 兼容转义，返回文本，不包标签。serializeTrustedSSRState(state) 跳过校验但仍执行这些转义。两者各只有一个必填参数，不是任意 HTML 上下文的通用转义器。

转义结果分别含字面反斜杠序列 \u0026、\u003c、\u003e、\u2028、\u2029，防止 payload 的 `</script>` 提前结束对应 script；JSON.parse 仍读回原字符。deserializeSSRState(text) 执行 JSON.parse 和 assertSSRState，SyntaxError 原位附 INVALID_STATE_SCRIPT，保留原生类型与 stack。
createSSRStateScript(state, elementId?) 把安全文本放入完整 application/json script 标签。state 必填；elementId 默认 `__STORE_STATE__`，须匹配 `/^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_:.-]*$/`，允许首个下划线并排除空白和引号，非法时 INVALID_STATE_SCRIPT。

readSSRStateFromDocument(elementId?, document?) 默认同一 id；document 默认 undefined，未传不读全局 DOM。document.getElementById(id) 返回含 textContent 与 getAttribute(name) 的元素或 null；没有元素或空内容返回 undefined。真实浏览器 document 满足此最小接口，非浏览器宿主也可显式实现它。返回数据仍须通过 SSR 校验。

sections.heading: 多 codec script 与读回

blocks.text: createSSRStateScriptWith(state, options) 和 readSSRStateFromDocumentWith(options) 是异步 API，options 必填：

rows: 必填，无默认；primaryType 选写入格式
默认 `__STORE_STATE__`；写入端校验上述正则，读取端按 id 原样查找
默认 undefined，透传给 registry encode/decode
仅读取，可选；省略返回 undefined

blocks.text: 如果 encode 返回 value chunk，以 TypeError / CODEC_CONTRACT 拒绝：SSR 需要线上文本或字节。primaryType 为 json 且 chunk 为 text 时使用 JSON 字符转义，属性为 data-codec="json" data-wire="text"。其他情况，包括 JSON 的 bytes，使用 base64，data-wire="b64"、type="text/plain"；不能把 JSON 转义套到 YAML 或二进制语法上。base64 字母表避免相关 HTML 分隔字符，编码体积约增加三分之一，这是编码规则而非速度测量。

多 codec 标签的 id 及 codec 属性按 HTML 属性规则转义 &、双引号、单引号、<、>。这不替代 id 的准入规则。读者取 data-codec（默认 json）与 data-wire（默认 text）决定还原方式；未注册写入类型以 CODEC_CONTRACT 拒绝，解码后的结果仍经过 assertSSRState。写入和读取必须有兼容 registry，registry.encode 本身不代替 SSR helper 的嵌入策略。

SsrWireType 是 { json: 'json', text: 'text', bytes: 'bytes' }，ISsrWireType 为值联合。json 比较 codec type，text/bytes 比较 chunk kind，不能把这三个词混为同一层。内部等待标签 SsrWorkOutcome/ISsrWorkOutcome 已从根入口收回，不增加 wrapper 或兼容 alias；awaitResources 仍直接返回失败数组。
本包构造错误的 source 为 STORE_SSR_SOURCE，即 @migaia/store-ssr；完整外包 source/code 保留原 owner。StoreSsrErrorCode 的 12 项如下：

rows: scope 已关闭后继续使用
多个 owned 清理失败，AggregateError 保留 errors
多条水合失败，非原子、其他成功不撤销
stores/resources、Resource 快照或其属性读取非法
外层版本、script id 或 JSON 解析非法
JSON 值域、循环或深度/节点预算不符
timeout、互斥 Runtime 选项、owned 或重复键非法
登记对象不属于当前 Runtime
value chunk 或读者未注册对应 codec
资源注册瀑布超过 64 轮

sections.heading: Ownership, entry point, and request isolation

blocks.text: The only entry is `@migaia/store-ssr`. It connects reactive-driven Stores/Resources to SSR snapshots, owning registration, prefetch waits, dehydration, hydration, and cleanup of accepted objects. Dependencies are reactive, resource, serialize, and utils. It has no rendering-framework binding and never reads globalThis.document.

A new SSRRequestScope creates a new Runtime by default. Store registration checks $runtime, and Resource registration checks runtime, against scope.runtime. Mismatches fail with CROSS_RUNTIME. claimOwnership records the scope object's owner; it does not exclusively reserve a Runtime. Two scopes may explicitly receive the same Runtime, so the application still owns request isolation. Create one independent scope per request, create its state with scope.runtime, and await disposeAsync in finally.

createStore and the Resource class already satisfy the respective interfaces below. A purely client-side application does not need this bridge, and this is not an arbitrary-object JSON converter. Whether the client refetches depends on Resource cache, TTL, and startup policy; hydration does not guarantee that every application request is eliminated.
createSSRRequestScope(options?) is equivalent to new SSRRequestScope(options?). Options default to an empty object.

A Resource without a dehydrated cache can return undefined. The $-prefixed Store names and unprefixed Resource names follow their existing contracts. The scope observes asynchronous Store cleanup; the Resource port has synchronous disposal. Structural adapters must define their own dehydrate/cache policy rather than expect the failure list to choose cached output for them.

blocks.text: Keys must be nonempty and cannot be `__proto__`. Duplicate Store or Resource keys fail with INVALID_OPTION rather than replacing registrations. Objects must belong to the scope Runtime. Owned entries are cleaned up on exit; owned false leaves lifecycle responsibility with the caller while participating in dehydration/hydration.

When hydration arrived before registration, the pending matching snapshot is applied before registration commits. If the callback fails while the scope remains active, the key stays free, the pending snapshot remains available for retry, and the candidate stays caller-owned. If the callback closes the scope, closure clears pending state and a post-hydration SCOPE_DISPOSED check rejects admission, even if the candidate has already received values.

Store unregistration removes the entry before invoking $dispose and tracks returned thenables. Resource unregistration calls dispose first; synchronous failure leaves the registration present for caller handling or detach. Detach never disposes and transfers lifecycle responsibility back to the caller.

hydrate(state) requires one state argument without options. It first validates the whole structure with assertSSRState, then applies $hydrate/hydrate to registered objects and stores unknown keys for later registration. Each call replaces the pending tables; absent keys from older pending state are not retained.

This is best-effort application rather than an atomic transaction. One callback failure does not prevent the other entries being attempted, and successful updates are not rolled back. One failure is thrown unchanged; multiple failures use HYDRATE_FAILED with AggregateError.errors retaining original objects and order. Matching keys, presence in the server payload, and whether an object was disposed before dehydration all affect restoration.

sections.heading: Safe dehydration and the trusted path

blocks.text: dehydrate() takes no arguments. It visits active registrations in sorted key order. Store $plain results are JSON-validated, deeply copied, and frozen. A Resource returning undefined is omitted. Otherwise its data receives the same validation/copying, while version, ageMs, and remainingTtlMs are preserved. The outer state, stores, and resources are frozen. Later source changes do not change this safe snapshot.

dehydrateTrusted() also takes no arguments, but it is not a snapshot. It retains live $plain()/dehydrate() references without JSON validation, deep copies, or deep freezing. An outer wrapper does not make all descendants immutable. The ITrustedSSRState brand prevents accidental typed input to serializeTrustedSSRState; it is not proof that untrusted application data is safe.

Use this path only when every value is already valid and cannot change before immediate serializeTrustedSSRState, with no intervening await or mutation. Prefer dehydrate by default. A brand is not validation of request input. dehydrate and dehydrateAsync produce data only; they do not perform HTML character escaping.

awaitResources(options?) returns readonly ISSRResourceFailure[], whose entries contain key and original error. Options default to {} and timeoutMs to undefined, meaning no deadline. A supplied timeout must be finite within [0, 2147483647], including fractional values. Invalid values reject the returned promise with RangeError / INVALID_OPTION.

The budget covers the whole wait, not a new allocation for every Resource. Successive rounds deduplicate by Promise identity. A retry/refetch promise or a Resource registered after another completes is still awaited. More than 64 rounds rejects with RESOURCE_ROUND_LIMIT.

A throwing promise getter is recorded once per key. A rejected promise retains its original reason. Deadline exhaustion marks only still-pending promises with RESOURCE_TIMEOUT, without misclassifying existing successes. Zero waits for no in-flight work but still recognizes settled promises. Scope closure promptly returns already collected failures without marking every remaining resource as timed out or cancelling its underlying work.

dehydrateAsync(options?) waits before safe dehydration. timeoutMs has the same contract. Optional onResourceError(failure) replaces default reporting; without it, each failure goes to runtime.reportError(error, { phase: 'ssr-resource' }). Failure keys are not a second payload filter: Resource.dehydrate decides whether cached data is included. An unbounded wait for a never-settled promise can remain pending; choose timeoutMs to match the request budget.

Resource v2 hydration restores captured remaining TTL. The caller accounts for known transport/storage delay by increasing ageMs and subtracting from finite remainingTtlMs, floored at zero. The outer ISSRState version remains 1.

sections.heading: Closing a scope and stable completion

blocks.text: dispose() takes no arguments, closes synchronously, and starts cleanup. disposeAsync() takes no arguments and returns a stable Promise<void>. First closure marks disposed, clears registrations/pending hydration, and publishes completion before invoking cleanup. Synchronous reentry sees the same promise. Concurrent, completed, and failed repeated calls reuse it without another cleanup pass.

Owned Resources release in reverse registration order, then owned Stores in reverse order; already disposed objects are skipped. Failure never prevents later entries being attempted. Synchronous dispose can throw synchronous failures without waiting for Store thenables. disposeAsync waits for tracked jobs, preserves a single failure, and aggregates multiple failures under SCOPE_DISPOSAL_FAILED. It also waits for still-tracked Store cleanup started by earlier unregister calls.

The scope does not dispose the Runtime itself. After closure, registration, removal, detach, hydrate, dehydration, and resource waits fail with SCOPE_DISPOSED. Synchronous methods throw; asynchronous wait methods reject. Reading runtime/disposed and repeated closure remain available. A scope cannot be revived.

ISSRState requires version 1 and a plain stores record; resources is optional. Each Store value must be a JSON object, with a nonempty key other than `__proto__`. Resource snapshots require version 2, data, finite non-negative ageMs, and remainingTtlMs that is null or finite/non-negative. assertSSRState(value) takes one required value without options and narrows its type; it does not create a deep copy.

The JSON domain is null, strings, booleans, finite numbers, ordinary records, and arrays. It rejects Date/Map/Set/class instances, nonfinite numbers, undefined/functions/symbols/bigint, ancestor cycles, depth above 256, and node counts above 1000000. Paths identify locations such as stores.app.count or resources.user.data[2].name. Acyclic repeated references are not ancestor cycles. Copying and validation share rejection order.

INVALID_SNAPSHOT covers store/resource structure and Resource snapshots. Invalid outer versions use INVALID_STATE_SCRIPT. Unreadable unknown snapshot properties preserve the native object or cause rather than replacing the failure with text. Unsupported JSON values produce TypeError / SERIALIZE_UNSUPPORTED.

sections.heading: JSON text, HTML embedding, and explicit documents

blocks.text: serializeSSRState(state) validates, JSON-stringifies, and escapes &, <, >, U+2028, and U+2029 using JSON-compatible escapes. It returns text without a tag. serializeTrustedSSRState(state) skips validation but still escapes these characters. Both require one argument and are not general-purpose escaping for arbitrary HTML contexts.

The output contains literal escape sequences \u0026, \u003c, \u003e, \u2028, and \u2029, preventing a payload's `</script>` from ending its enclosing element while JSON.parse restores the original characters. deserializeSSRState(text) parses and validates; malformed JSON keeps native SyntaxError and its stack while receiving INVALID_STATE_SCRIPT.

createSSRStateScript(state, elementId?) wraps safe text in a complete application/json script element. State is required. The id defaults to `__STORE_STATE__` and must match `/^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_:.-]*$/`, allowing the leading underscore but excluding whitespace/quotes. Invalid ids produce INVALID_STATE_SCRIPT.

readSSRStateFromDocument(elementId?, document?) uses the same default id. Document defaults to undefined; the module never discovers a global DOM. getElementById(id) returns an element with textContent/getAttribute(name), or null. Missing elements or empty content return undefined. A browser document satisfies the minimal interface, and another host can explicitly provide it. Returned state still passes SSR validation.

sections.heading: Capture a request snapshot and release its owned store

blocks.text: A page finishes rendering, but the live store changes before its state is serialized. The exported state should retain the values captured for that render, and request cleanup must release its owned store.
Keeping a live nested object as the response payload lets later mutations rewrite the earlier result. A request handler that forgets store disposal also leaves subscriptions and cleanup jobs behind.
Install store-ssr and store-light directly. Create the Store with scope.runtime, register it, then call dehydrate() for a checked frozen snapshot and await disposeAsync() when the request ends.
createSSRRequestScope() uses no options and creates a Runtime; register requires the key and Store, defaults owned to true, and receives a Store created with scope.runtime.

import { createSSRRequestScope } from '@migaia/store-ssr'

sections.heading: Keep two requests in separate runtimes

blocks.text: Concurrent requests register the same profile key for different users. They need separate state and must reject a Store accidentally created for the other request.
A module-level Runtime or shared registry lets request-specific state share one owner. Giving scopes different names cannot correct a Store that was constructed with the wrong Runtime.
createSSRRequestScope creates a new Runtime by default. Build each real store-light Store with its own scope.runtime; register() checks exact Runtime identity before accepting the foreign candidate.
Both scopes use their default fresh Runtime; identical keys belong to separate registries, and register checks Store.$runtime before admission.
Prints `false`, `Alice Bob`, and `CROSS_RUNTIME`. The default scopes have different Runtimes, identical keys hold separate user values, and the foreign registration is refused.

Passing the same explicit runtime to multiple scopes reuses it and does not create request isolation. runtime and runtimeOptions are mutually exclusive. Failed registration retains caller ownership; closing one scope does not release objects owned by the other.

sections.heading: Keep ready data when another resource exceeds the wait budget

blocks.text: A render has one ready cache entry and one request still pending when its waiting budget ends. The completed entry should remain usable without being mislabeled as a timeout.
Timing out an entire Promise.all call loses which resources actually settled. Retrying every resource discards available cache data and repeats work that already succeeded.

Install resource directly. dehydrateAsync({ timeoutMs: 0 }) classifies already-settled promises without waiting for pending work; onResourceError collects failures, and the ready Resource uses a 60000 ms cache TTL.
Resources use scope.runtime; ttl defaults to Infinity, and this example overrides ready to 60000 ms; timeoutMs: 0 is a zero budget for the whole wait, and onResourceError replaces default reporting.

Prints `pending RESOURCE_TIMEOUT` and `7`. Only the unresolved resource is reported; the successfully cached value remains in the dehydrated resource state. The example then resolves the pending loader and closes the scope.

timeoutMs defaults to no deadline and applies to the whole wait. A timeout does not abort underlying work. Resource inclusion follows resource.dehydrate(), without independently filtering failure keys; a stale cache can remain eligible.

sections.heading: Embed JSON without letting data close its script element

blocks.text: A user-supplied text contains `</script>`, an ampersand or Unicode line separators. Inlining ordinary JSON into an HTML script element can make the HTML parser treat data as markup.
JSON.stringify escapes JSON syntax but does not remove a literal closing script tag from string contents. Escaping the whole document afterward can instead corrupt the JSON representation.

serializeSSRState first validates the version-1 state and then escapes &, <, >, U+2028 and U+2029 with JSON-compatible sequences. deserializeSSRState reads the escaped text back and verifies the same value.
state must be a valid version-1 SSR envelope; serializeSSRState and deserializeSSRState each take one required argument without options.

blocks.code:
import { serializeSSRState, deserializeSSRState } from '@migaia/store-ssr'

const value = '</script>&\u2028\u2029'
const state = { version: 1 as const, stores: { page: { text: value } } }
const text = serializeSSRState(state)
console.log(
  text.includes('<'),
  text.includes('&'),
  text.includes('\u2028'),
  text.includes('\u2029')
)
console.log(deserializeSSRState(text).stores.page?.text === value)

blocks.text: Prints `false false false false` and `true`. The serialized text contains none of the checked raw HTML-sensitive characters or line separators, while JSON parsing recovers the original string exactly.

Use the returned text as JSON script content; the function does not add a script element. State version must be 1 and values must meet the supported JSON domain. Invalid parsed JSON retains SyntaxError with INVALID_STATE_SCRIPT.

sections.heading: Create the complete non-executable state element

blocks.text: A renderer has a validated state envelope but still needs a consistently named element for browser hydration. The response should include data without turning that JSON into executable JavaScript.
Hand-written tag templates can disagree about the element id or MIME type. Inlining the JSON without its matching escaping also reintroduces closing-tag handling into every renderer.
createSSRStateScript validates the state and element id, serializes with HTML-compatible JSON escapes, and wraps the result in an application/json script. Omit elementId to use `__STORE_STATE__`.
state is required, elementId defaults to `__STORE_STATE__`, and the result is tag text rather than a DOM insertion.
Prints `<script type="application/json" id="__STORE_STATE__">{"version":1,"stores":{"app":{"count":2}}}</script>`. The default id and non-executable JSON MIME type appear in the complete tag.

This function builds HTML text and does not insert DOM nodes or hydrate Stores. A browser reader can use readSSRStateFromDocument with the same id and an explicitly supplied document; that reader does not obtain a global document automatically.

sections.heading: Reject identifiers that can break the state element attribute

blocks.text: A renderer selects an element id from configuration. If quotes or whitespace are accepted, the value can escape its id attribute and change the generated markup.
Interpolating an arbitrary configuration string into a tag treats that value as HTML syntax. Merely agreeing on an id between server and browser does not validate the attribute boundary.

createSSRStateScript requires an id beginning with a letter or underscore, followed by letters, digits, underscores, colons, dots or hyphens. Show a valid custom id, then reject one containing a quote and spaces.
elementId is the second argument and defaults to `__STORE_STATE__`; it must match /^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_:.-]*$/, otherwise INVALID_STATE_SCRIPT is thrown.
Prints `true` and `Error INVALID_STATE_SCRIPT`. The valid page-state id is rendered; the attempted attribute-breaking id is rejected before a tag is returned.

The default id is `__STORE_STATE__`, and empty or nonmatching ids reject. State data is separately validated and JSON-escaped; this identifier rule does not provide a general HTML sanitization policy for other markup.

Matching keys, presence in the server payload, and whether an object was disposed before dehydration all affect restoration.

sections.heading: Safe dehydration and the trusted path

blocks.text: dehydrate() takes no arguments. It visits active registrations in sorted key order. Store $plain results are JSON-validated, deeply copied, and frozen. A Resource returning undefined is omitted. Otherwise its data receives the same validation/copying, while version, ageMs, and remainingTtlMs are preserved. The outer state, stores, and resources are frozen. Later source changes do not change this safe snapshot.

dehydrateTrusted() also takes no arguments, but it is not a snapshot. It retains live $plain()/dehydrate() references without JSON validation, deep copies, or deep freezing. An outer wrapper does not make all descendants immutable. The ITrustedSSRState brand prevents accidental typed input to serializeTrustedSSRState; it is not proof that untrusted application data is safe.

Use this path only when every value is already valid and cannot change before immediate serializeTrustedSSRState, with no intervening await or mutation. Prefer dehydrate by default. A brand is not validation of request input. dehydrate and dehydrateAsync produce data only; they do not perform HTML character escaping.

awaitResources(options?) returns readonly ISSRResourceFailure[], whose entries contain key and original error. Options default to {} and timeoutMs to undefined, meaning no deadline. A supplied timeout must be finite within [0, 2147483647], including fractional values. Invalid values reject the returned promise with RangeError / INVALID_OPTION.

The budget covers the whole wait, not a new allocation for every Resource. Successive rounds deduplicate by Promise identity. A retry/refetch promise or a Resource registered after another completes is still awaited. More than 64 rounds rejects with RESOURCE_ROUND_LIMIT.

A throwing promise getter is recorded once per key. A rejected promise retains its original reason. Deadline exhaustion marks only still-pending promises with RESOURCE_TIMEOUT, without misclassifying existing successes. Zero waits for no in-flight work but still recognizes settled promises. Scope closure promptly returns already collected failures without marking every remaining resource as timed out or cancelling its underlying work.

dehydrateAsync(options?) waits before safe dehydration. timeoutMs has the same contract. Optional onResourceError(failure) replaces default reporting; without it, each failure goes to runtime.reportError(error, { phase: 'ssr-resource' }). Failure keys are not a second payload filter: Resource.dehydrate decides whether cached data is included. An unbounded wait for a never-settled promise can remain pending; choose timeoutMs to match the request budget.

Resource v2 hydration restores captured remaining TTL. The caller accounts for known transport/storage delay by increasing ageMs and subtracting from finite remainingTtlMs, floored at zero. The outer ISSRState version remains 1.

sections.heading: Closing a scope and stable completion

blocks.text: dispose() takes no arguments, closes synchronously, and starts cleanup. disposeAsync() takes no arguments and returns a stable Promise<void>. First closure marks disposed, clears registrations/pending hydration, and publishes completion before invoking cleanup. Synchronous reentry sees the same promise. Concurrent, completed, and failed repeated calls reuse it without another cleanup pass.

Owned Resources release in reverse registration order, then owned Stores in reverse order; already disposed objects are skipped. Failure never prevents later entries being attempted. Synchronous dispose can throw synchronous failures without waiting for Store thenables. disposeAsync waits for tracked jobs, preserves a single failure, and aggregates multiple failures under SCOPE_DISPOSAL_FAILED. It also waits for still-tracked Store cleanup started by earlier unregister calls.

The scope does not dispose the Runtime itself. After closure, registration, removal, detach, hydrate, dehydration, and resource waits fail with SCOPE_DISPOSED. Synchronous methods throw; asynchronous wait methods reject. Reading runtime/disposed and repeated closure remain available. A scope cannot be revived.

ISSRState requires version 1 and a plain stores record; resources is optional. Each Store value must be a JSON object, with a nonempty key other than `__proto__`. Resource snapshots require version 2, data, finite non-negative ageMs, and remainingTtlMs that is null or finite/non-negative. assertSSRState(value) takes one required value without options and narrows its type; it does not create a deep copy.

The JSON domain is null, strings, booleans, finite numbers, ordinary records, and arrays. It rejects Date/Map/Set/class instances, nonfinite numbers, undefined/functions/symbols/bigint, ancestor cycles, depth above 256, and node counts above 1000000. Paths identify locations such as stores.app.count or resources.user.data[2].name. Acyclic repeated references are not ancestor cycles. Copying and validation share rejection order.

INVALID_SNAPSHOT covers store/resource structure and Resource snapshots. Invalid outer versions use INVALID_STATE_SCRIPT. Unreadable unknown snapshot properties preserve the native object or cause rather than replacing the failure with text. Unsupported JSON values produce TypeError / SERIALIZE_UNSUPPORTED.

sections.heading: JSON text, HTML embedding, and explicit documents

blocks.text: serializeSSRState(state) validates, JSON-stringifies, and escapes &, <, >, U+2028, and U+2029 using JSON-compatible escapes. It returns text without a tag. serializeTrustedSSRState(state) skips validation but still escapes these characters. Both require one argument and are not general-purpose escaping for arbitrary HTML contexts.

The output contains literal escape sequences \u0026, \u003c, \u003e, \u2028, and \u2029, preventing a payload's `</script>` from ending its enclosing element while JSON.parse restores the original characters. deserializeSSRState(text) parses and validates; malformed JSON keeps native SyntaxError and its stack while receiving INVALID_STATE_SCRIPT.

createSSRStateScript(state, elementId?) wraps safe text in a complete application/json script element. State is required. The id defaults to `__STORE_STATE__` and must match `/^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_:.-]*$/`, allowing the leading underscore but excluding whitespace/quotes. Invalid ids produce INVALID_STATE_SCRIPT.

readSSRStateFromDocument(elementId?, document?) uses the same default id. Document defaults to undefined; the module never discovers a global DOM. getElementById(id) returns an element with textContent/getAttribute(name), or null. Missing elements or empty content return undefined. A browser document satisfies the minimal interface, and another host can explicitly provide it. Returned state still passes SSR validation.
createSSRStateScriptWith(state, options) and readSSRStateFromDocumentWith(options) are asynchronous and require options.

blocks.text: A value chunk fails with TypeError / CODEC_CONTRACT because SSR needs wire text or bytes. Json primaryType plus a text chunk uses JSON escaping and data-codec="json" data-wire="text". Every other case, including JSON bytes, uses base64 with data-wire="b64" and type="text/plain". Applying JSON escapes to YAML or binary would corrupt their syntax. The base64 alphabet avoids the relevant HTML delimiters and increases encoded size by roughly one third; this is an encoding property rather than a speed measurement.

Codec script id and codec attributes escape &, double/single quotes, <, and > as HTML attributes, in addition to id admission. Reading uses data-codec, default json, and data-wire, default text. An unregistered writer type fails with CODEC_CONTRACT; decoded output still passes assertSSRState. Writer and reader registries must be compatible. registry.encode alone does not provide the SSR helper's embedding policy.

SsrWireType is { json: 'json', text: 'text', bytes: 'bytes' }, and ISsrWireType is its value union. Json is a codec-type comparison, while text/bytes identify chunk kinds. On the server, create a scope per request and real Stores/Resources using its Runtime. Register keys, dehydrateAsync when prefetching, emit through the corresponding serialize/script helper, then await disposeAsync in finally. Supplying initial snapshots, sending responses, and rendering are host responsibilities.

For CROSS_RUNTIME, check the Runtime supplied at object creation. For missing hydration, check keys, server entries, and disposal. symbols.purpose: Mutually exclusive Runtime construction choices.
symbols.core:
runtime: Existing IRuntime from @migaia/reactive createRuntime, mutually exclusive with runtimeOptions. The scope claims its own instance, not exclusive ownership of that Runtime. Applications provide a distinct Runtime and scope per request when isolation is required.
Creates an isolated Runtime.
runtimeOptions: IRuntimeOptions forwarded to reactive createRuntime when runtime is absent; callback, adapter and scheduler contracts remain defined by reactive.
Reactive defaults: microtask flushing, default host adapter and 100 maxFlushPasses.
runtimeOptions.adapter: Host capabilities: `scheduleMicrotask`, `now` (monotonic time), `timestamp` (epoch time) and `reportError`. Each missing entry falls back to the default.
`queueMicrotask`, `performance.now()`, `Date.now()` and a reporter that does nothing.
runtimeOptions.onError: Receives errors that the runtime cannot throw to a caller (effect failures during an async flush, lifecycle hook failures, trace listener failures) with a `phase` context. Synchronous reporter failures and returned thenable rejections reach the shared utils host exception queue, without changing graph operations.
Not set: errors go to `adapter.reportError`.
Set it in every long-lived runtime. An automatic flush runs in a microtask, so a failing effect has no caller to throw to; without `onError` the default adapter drops the error and the page just stops updating. Read `context.phase` and `context.observer?.debugName` to see which effect failed.
runtimeOptions.onTrace: Receives every trace event from creation on, same as calling `subscribeTrace` immediately.
Not set: no trace events are produced unless `subscribeTrace` is used.
Use it while diagnosing why an effect reruns too often, or to feed a devtools panel from the first node on. `subscribeTrace` called later misses the events of nodes created before it; `onTrace` sees them all. Each event names nodes by `debugName`, so give the nodes you care about a name.
runtimeOptions.maxFlushPasses: Maximum runs of one effect within one flush. Exceeding it is treated as a self-triggering loop: the queue is cleared and `FLUSH_LOOP` is thrown with the dropped node names. Must be a positive integer.
`100` runs per effect per flush.
runtimeOptions.scheduleIdle: Schedules cleanup work, such as suspending computed values nobody observes. Use it to align cleanup with animation frames or idle callbacks.
Uses `adapter.scheduleMicrotask`.
Use it when many computed values lose their last observer at once, for example when a large list unmounts, and the cleanup should not compete with the next interaction. Passing `requestIdleCallback` moves that cleanup to idle time; reading the computed again before then simply keeps it alive.
runtimeOptions.schedulerStrategy: Decides when pending effects flush: receives a `flush` function and calls it when appropriate (for example in `requestAnimationFrame`). It must call synchronously or schedule; returning a thenable falls back to the safe default and reports `INVALID_OPTION`.
Merge all writes of the current task into one microtask flush.

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: The methods needed to manage loaded data within one server request: wait for loading, save or restore cached data, and release the resource. [Resource](/en/docs/resource/api/Resource) provides these methods. Construct it with scope.runtime, the request scope’s execution context, and pass it to scope.registerResource. The scope can then wait for it, ask it for cached data, and clean it up by default. Without registration, the scope does not manage it. A resource using a different runtime makes registration throw CROSS_RUNTIME. Resource itself defines whether cached data is available to save.

symbols.purpose: A request scope groups the stores used by one server request. This type lists the methods it needs to save state, restore it, and release a store. [Store Light’s createStore](/en/docs/store-light/api/createStore) returns a compatible object. Create the store with runtime: scope.runtime, sharing the scope’s execution context, then pass it to scope.register. The scope can then collect its state for a request snapshot and owns cleanup by default. Without registration, the scope does not collect or clean up that store. Using a different runtime makes registration throw CROSS_RUNTIME.

$disposed: Terminal flag checked for dehydration/cleanup omission.
$plain: Synchronous plain data callback, never a Promise.

$hydrate: Synchronous data application callback without transactional rollback.
$hydrate.state: Store field record from validated state.

members.name: hydrate
members.description: Applies validated JSON state best-effort rather than atomically. A store or resource can reject its own hydration; every other entry is still attempted and failures are collected. The contracts provide no stage/commit/rollback protocol, so successful changes remain applied. Pending hydration records always reflect the entries actually consumed, including when a later entry fails. Callers must handle partial application rather than assume rollback. Each call replaces pending tables for unregistered keys. One hydration callback failure is rethrown by identity; several become HYDRATE_FAILED with ordered errors.

members.name: dehydrate
members.description: Copy/freeze JSON Store state and includable resource data, sorting keys and omitting disposed or valueless entries. Getters may execute. Unsupported values, cycles or depth/node limits fail with SERIALIZE_UNSUPPORTED; closed scopes throw SCOPE_DISPOSED. No HTML encoding or waiting occurs.

members.name: dehydrateTrusted
members.description: Returns live business references without copying, deep-freezing or validation. Outer state and registration maps are shallow-frozen; later mutations to retained business values can change the payload before serialization, including across an await; this is not a snapshot. Use only for known-safe JSON data that stays immutable through serialization, such as owned documentation/demo fixtures. Request input or concurrently mutable stores must use dehydrate() instead. Select this unchecked path only when skipping validation and copying is justified. The TypeScript brand is not runtime validation; closed scopes throw SCOPE_DISPOSED.

members.name: awaitResources
members.description: Waits for registered asynchronous resources in rounds and returns their failures. Callers can fail the page or refetch on the client. New waterfall registrations participate in later rounds. Promises are deduplicated by identity, so a new retry or refetch promise for the same key is awaited. One resource failure does not block other prefetches. Thrown promise getters and timeouts are included in the failure list. Disposal during the wait returns results already collected without marking remaining resources as failures. The timeout is one total budget, with no deadline by default; waiting observes late rejection but never aborts resource work. Nonconverging waterfalls reject RESOURCE_ROUND_LIMIT, invalid budgets reject INVALID_OPTION, and an already-closed scope rejects SCOPE_DISPOSED.

members.name: dehydrateAsync
members.description: Takes a snapshot after prefetching. Each resource decides inclusion through its own dehydrate() result; the failure list does not independently filter payload keys. members.name: dispose

members.name: disposeAsync
